title: Trump's $5,000 Dividend Offer Is a Gimmick, Says Beto O'Rourke
description:
Beto O’Rourke said President Donald Trump’s promise to pay American adults $5,000 apiece is a "gimmick" and will never be paid. The former US representative from Texas says Republicans can't offer voters real change. He also talks about how Democratic Senate candidate James Talarico can win his race in Texas. O'Rourke speaks to Bloomberg's Julie Fine and Kailey Leinz in Dallas.
